format_divergence.reason_en: Fourth checkpoint in a row diverging the same way, for the same reason: the module is receptive, so transform and error-spot questions have nothing to test. Four of the eight are now written this way. If the Part F mix is mandatory, this is the point to say so — reworking four is still cheap, reworking eight is not.

questions.question_en: Listen again. How does the customer raise the problem?
options: He accuses the waiter of a mistake
He states what they did not order and leaves the rest unsaid
He asks to see the manager
questions.explanation_en: ये तो हमने ऑर्डर नहीं किया states a fact. Nobody is blamed out loud, and the waiter fixes it anyway.

questions.question_en: Listen again. How does the guest eventually stop the host offering more?
options: The host stops on her own
By saying he is full and will have more next time
questions.explanation_en: पेट भर गया, then बस आंटी, अगली बार. Notice the host never actually accepts the refusal — she just stops.

questions.question_en: Across the clinic dialogues, which is true of the patient?
options: Vomiting and weakness for a week
Only a headache, and no other medication
Fever that is worse in the morning
Fever for two days, no appetite, and already on a BP tablet
questions.explanation_en: दो दिन से बुख़ार, भूख नहीं लग रही, and बीपी की गोली लेता हूँ. The fever is worse at night, not the morning.

questions.question_en: You hear छह रोटियाँ लिखी हैं in one dialogue and रोटियाँ बेटी ने बनाईं in another. Why does one have the nasal and the other not?
options: The nasal goes on the last word of the verb phrase — the auxiliary takes it when there is one
बनाना always keeps the nasal and लिखना never does
One is a question and one is a statement
questions.explanation_en: लिखी हैं has an auxiliary, so हैं carries the nasal. बनाईं has nothing after it, so the participle keeps it.

questions.question_en: बोतल का पानी and मरीज़ का नाम both use का. What is it doing in the first one?
options: Possession — the bottle owns the water
Source or material — water that comes from a bottle
It marks the object of a verb
questions.explanation_en: का covers material and source as well as possession — मिट्टी का घड़ा, सोने की चेन, बोतल का पानी.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: मैं कार्ड ___ दे देता हूँ, तुम लोग बाद में भेज देना।
questions.question_read_as: maiṁ kaarḍ ___ de detaa huuṁ, tum log baad meṁ bhej denaa.
questions.explanation_en: से for the instrument — the thing the action happens through.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: दही भी डाल ___ ?
questions.explanation_en: First-person subjunctive — shall I? दो would be an instruction to the customer.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: हाँ यार, बाक़ी ___ से बेहतर।
questions.explanation_en: से is a postposition, so the plural goes oblique.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: ये सब्ज़ी ___ बनाई?
questions.explanation_en: बनाना is transitive and the tense is perfective, so ने.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: पेट ___, यहाँ नीचे।
questions.explanation_en: The body part takes में — the pain is located inside it.
